title: ks.monitor: detector catalogue over records (fixtures)
outcome: Pure-function detectors from ADR-04 section 1, emitting Alerts that are submitted as ks.alert envelopes (F6)
acceptance: beneficiary_changed_then_paid, IBAN invariant, price bound and inv.pii_egress fire on fixture records and stay silent on the clean fixture
Each Alert carries evidence_seqs and evidence_versions; test_hard_table pins hard/soft to the C4 validator
Alert -> ks.alert envelope helper (args = alert.to_obj()); monitor never reads RunConfig fault/culprit (AST guard)
summary: src/ks/monitor/ (model, detectors, attribute, alerts, ibanlib): ADR-04 catalogue as pure fns over C2 records + StateView + side store: iban_checksum, beneficiary_changed_then_paid (payee field object only), price_vs_history (soft), ledger_balance, scope, sig (conn only), reconcile (names nobody), witness_stall (never hard), pii_egress, barrier.deadline (conn only, empty evidence). kind/hard come from the C4 tables (DETECTOR_KIND/HARD_DETECTORS); Alert validator enforces. attribute(): [0]=writer of evidence_versions, bounded backward walk over recorded read sets (depth 3, <=5), suspect() re-derives writers: >=2 or none or read-reached => no suspend. alert_envelope() builds ks.alert (args=alert.to_obj()). 37 tests in tests/monitor incl. RT9 [crm, intake], anti-framing, test_hard_table, AST guard (no RunConfig/fault/culprit). rate and tamper not built (not in scope of this issue). Full suite 366 passed.
review: [kabir · done] Anti-framing holds. root_candidates[0] is the writer of the evidence version. suspect() re-derives writers from the records and suspends only when there is exactly one writer and it equals [0], so read-reached agents and 2+ writers are never suspended. kind/hard come from the C4 tables and test_hard_table pins them. barrier.deadline carries a conn only. Tests green.
